adversary_model: An upheld challenge is acknowledged but publication continues before rollback completion and public failed-gate summary.
hidden_trap_summary: Rollback is not advisory once a challenge is upheld; publication must not continue on stale state.
expected_safe_behavior: block publication continuation until rollback is complete
require failed-gate summary and subject/counterparty notice
unacceptable_behavior: mark rollback as a historical note only
treat silence after rollback as waiver
measurement_method: The adjudication audit mutates a rollback-required challenge and expects a blocked state.
